capabilities.name: Policy limits/category rules
capabilities.verify: Dual-surface DONE 2026-07-06. Skill: manage_expense_policy upsert live over gateway (baseline '*' cap 50000/receipt/approval>20000 → policy_id). UI: Policies tab in ExpensesPage + useExpensePolicies hook (list/upsert/delete, cap/receipt/approval-threshold). evaluate_expense_policy consumer verified 2026-06-14.
capabilities.notes: Backend verified 2026-06-14; admin UI built + Stage-3 live 2026-07-06.

capabilities.name: Mileage/per-diem rate tables
capabilities.verify: expense_rate_tables seeded with Skatteverket 2025 tax-free rates (mileage 25 kr/mil = 7331, per-diem full 290 kr / half 145 kr / night 145 kr = 7321). Admin UI: Rates tab in ExpensesPage. AddExpenseDialog has Mileage/Per-diem modes that auto-compute amount = quantity × active rate. Effective-dated (valid_from) + versioning + archive. get_expense_rate(code, date) helper returns the active version.

capabilities.name: Multi-currency FX conversion
capabilities.verify: expenses.base_currency / base_amount_cents / base_vat_cents / fx_rate_source + BEFORE trigger (20261005110000): a foreign receipt is converted at exchange_rates on expense_date (direct or inverse pair) into platform_default_currency(); no rate → fx_rate_source 'missing', base NULL — never 1:1; a caller-given exchange_rate is 'manual'. submit total, book_expense_report (refuses while a rate is missing, re-resolves one added later) and mark_expense_report_paid sum the base amounts; po claims use the base net. UI: amount cell shows ≈ base @ rate or 'no rate'. Battery procure-to-pay: 100 EUR @ 11 → 1 100 kr / 209 kr VAT; NOK without rate blocks booking until set_exchange_rate; 50 USD @ 10.5 manual → 525 kr; ledger 3 105 kr owed, balanced.
capabilities.notes: Built 2026-10-07 on the sweep. Odoo converts at the expense date's company rate; same here, with the strict stop when no rate exists.

capabilities.name: Approval delegation
capabilities.verify: approval_delegations table (from_user, to_user, starts_at, ends_at) with helper manage_approval_delegation RPC. Admin UI: Delegations tab in ExpensesPage — create/revoke with date range. Active window derived from starts_at/ends_at. Used by approval routing across all approval chains, not just expenses.

capabilities.name: PO-to-expense matching
capabilities.verify: expenses.purchase_order_id + po_match_status (matched / variance / over_claimed) / po_variance_cents / po_match_notes; match_expense_to_po(p_expense_id, p_purchase_order_id, p_tolerance_pct, p_force) RPC + skill: refuses a draft/cancelled order, a receipt without a rate, and a claim beyond what remains on the order (ordered net − vendor invoices − other matched expenses, base currency) unless p_force; unlinks with no order. po_invoiced_value_cents — the reader match_invoice_to_receipt and the payment gate use — now counts matched expenses, so a vendor invoice after an expense sees less remaining. Trigger re-evaluates when the amount changes. UI: PO select in AddExpenseDialog, PO badge with status in the list (20261005110000). Battery procure-to-pay: 600 kr net of 1 000 kr matched (400 remains), 500 kr refused, forced → over_claimed 100 kr, unlink restores, claimed value 60 000 öre read by the shared reader.
capabilities.notes: Built 2026-10-07 on the sweep. Odoo has no PO↔expense link in hr.expense; this closes the double-payment path (expense + vendor bill on one delivery).

capabilities.name: Bulk approve/reject
capabilities.verify: ExpenseReportsTab has checkbox multi-select on submitted reports plus an action bar with Approve selected (loops approve_expense_report RPC) and Reject selected (batch UPDATE to rejected status with reason prompt). Single-row Reject also added.
